games.title: Tobu Tobu Girl
games.description: Bounce, dash and boost through the sky to rescue your floating cat.
games.controls: Enter (Start): skip intro / menu. Arrows: steer. Z (A): dash. X (B): boost.
games.learn: The original climbing adventure, with three dashes before you must bounce again.
games.inspector_hint: Watch tile scrolling, sprite priority and pulse-channel music while you play.
games.author: Tangram Games; music by potato-tan
games.modifications: ROM bytes unchanged; filename normalized for the library.
